title: Dover AFB - AMC Museum Collection Management and Exhibit Design
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE AIR FORCE.AIR MOBILITY COMMAND.FA4497  436 CONS LGC
detail_text: Point of Contact: Send responses to the Contracting Officer, Contract Specialist, and Commodities & Services Flight organization box listed below: Contracting Officer: Ms. Anna George anna.george.2@us.af.mil (302) 677-5042 Contract Specialist: 2d Lt Travis Ambrose Travis.ambrose.1@us.af.mil (302) 677-5033 Org Box: 436CONS.PKB.ORG@us.af.mil Description of Requirement: The Air Mobility Command (AMC) Museum at Dover Air Force Base (AFB), Delaware requires services for collections support functions, artifact registration, artifact restoration support, and basic conservation services (including artifact cleaning, handling, repair, and preservation) of the AMC Museum’s permanent, historic reference. Additionally, the contractor shall be responsible for all operational and exhibit signage, and marketing ads with graphics. Please see the attached PWS/SOW for a more in-depth overview of the requirement. Codes for Services or Supplies: NAICS: 712110 Museums PSC: M1JA Operation of Museums and Exhibition Buildings Questions: In your response, please provide the following information: Is your company a large or small business? If applicable, indicate a best NAICS code for this acquisition not listed above. If applicable, what is your company’s socioeconomic status?
